source.zh: 作者课题组取值：水中觉察阈值，取自 L.J. van Gemert (2011) 汇编中的数值，由作者课题组选定并用于母乳风味研究（相关工作见 Cui 等，Food Bioscience，2026，doi:10.1016/j.fbio.2026.110162）。汇编中未收录的物质，取值出自已发表的 Food Chemistry 文献，逐条注明年份和 DOI。
source.en: Author group values: odour detection thresholds in water taken from the L.J. van Gemert (2011) compilation and selected by the author's group for its human milk flavour research (related work: Cui et al., Food Bioscience, 2026, doi:10.1016/j.fbio.2026.110162). For compounds not in the compilation, values come from published Food Chemistry articles; each is listed with year and DOI.
source.vg2011: L.J. van Gemert (2011). Odour Thresholds: Compilations of Odour Threshold Values in Air, Water and Other Media, 2nd ed. Oliemans Punter & Partners BV, Utrecht. Part II (water).
